biological_calibration.reason: No compatible audited training/held-out observations for the provisional 3D interaction model.

assessment.interval_scope: Marginal approximate paired-seed 90% t intervals; no simultaneous coverage claim.

build.flags: Release; DIM=3; native architecture; CPU; no graphical viewer
build.pilot: stock aster_dynamic.cym shortened to 100 timesteps and seed 41; 11 exported 3D frames; two-condition durable-worker regression also passed

plan.decision: Approximate90% Student t interval (df15, critical1.75305) for fine-minus-middle paired mean must lie wholly within prespecified margin; otherwise convergence not established.
plan.distribution_comparison: Paired seed differences across dt; common initial draws, not identical stochastic paths. All seed failures retained.
plan.limits: Short engineering sensitivity study only; no biological calibration, sample count, p-value or faithful paper57 reproduction. Coarse/fine results and unsuccessful conditions retained.
